name: vss-bridge
description: Dreamweaver-style Visual SourceSafe integration for VS Code. Asks 'View or Check Out?' when you open a file, and adds Check In, Undo Checkout, Get Latest and History commands, multi-file check in/out, and Explorer badges for checked-out files. Developed by Moiz Bohra.

vssBridge.ssExePath.description: Full path to ss.exe (Visual SourceSafe command line utility). Example: C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual SourceSafe\ss.exe

vssBridge.databasePath.description: Path to the FOLDER that contains srcsafe.ini of your VSS database (this becomes the SSDIR environment variable). Example: \\vssserver\vss\  or  D:\VSS\MyDatabase

vssBridge.username.description: VSS username used for checkout / checkin operations.

vssBridge.password.description: VSS password. WARNING: stored in plain text in settings.json. Prefer workspace settings and protect the file, or leave empty if your account has no password.

vssBridge.vssProject.description: VSS project path mapped to the first workspace folder. Example: $/MyProject/webapp/api - so that C:\dev\api\test.php maps to $/MyProject/webapp/api/test.php

local.description: Local folder, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. webapp\\api) or an absolute path

vssBridge.mappings.description: Folder-level VSS mappings for when the local folder layout does not mirror the VSS tree. Deepest match wins; everything else uses vssBridge.vssProject. Example: [ { "local": "webapp\\api", "vss": "$/MyProject/webapp/api" } ]

vssBridge.promptOnOpen.description: When you open a file, ask 'Check Out or View only?' (Dreamweaver style). Files that are already checked out by you are skipped automatically.

vssBridge.ignoredFileTypes.description: File extensions that should never trigger the View/Checkout prompt (binaries, build outputs, media).

vssBridge.autoGetWhenMissing.description: If the local file does not exist yet (fresh workspace), automatically run 'Get Latest' before showing the View/Checkout prompt.

vssBridge.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for each ss.exe operation before aborting it.

vssBridge.statusBarEnabled.description: Show VSS status of the active file (Checked in / Checked out by ...) in the status bar.

vssBridge.explorerDecorations.description: Show a ✓ badge in the Explorer on files checked out in VSS (green = by you, red = by someone else; hover for the name). Reads one VSS folder at a time, only for folders you have open.

vssBridge.explorerRefreshMinutes.description: How often the Explorer badges of visible folders are re-read from VSS, to pick up other people's checkouts. 0 = only after your own VSS actions and "VSS: Refresh Status".

colors.description: Explorer color of files you have checked out in VSS.
Explorer color of files someone else has checked out in VSS.
